entries.summary: On a host, run session claim from the host root (python3 .agents/scripts/session_state.py claim); session_start.py --boot can never claim the host anchor because repo_root() is the parent of scripts/ resolved via __file__ and every subprocess runs with cwd=repo_root, while ACTIVE_STATE is relative to CWD - a scripts/ symlink does not fix it.
Cursor PreToolUse hooks must emit {"permission":"allow|deny"} on stdout; wrap on_commit.py so its prose goes to stderr.
Do not seal an Accepted structure ADR or execute layout changes until the human has debated product shape in chat; a premature ADR must be reverted and the plan returned to DRAFT.
Casual OK is not Approval Gate while the human is still clarifying product intent; keep IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN in DRAFT and stay in chat until they ask to redact the project plan.
Under Cursor PreToolUse, stage files (and fix-regression tests) in one Bash call, then run git commit alone in a later call — the gate reads the index before the compound command executes.

Never theorize about a third-party DOM: write a probe that dumps the real attribute chain first, because three successive selector hypotheses for WhatsApp message direction were each wrong and each shipped.
Verify an export by field integrity, not by message count: 217 messages looked like success while 214 of them carried a clock in sender and body text in timestamp.
A harvest that stops without positive proof of the chat start must report complete:false; treating a stall as completion produced a truncated corpus labelled complete.

Never build a click target from broad selectors such as a or [tabindex] inside content: scope to panel chrome and reject any node inside a message bubble, or the harvester clicks links in the operator's live session.
Playwright needs the real filesystem: under the agent sandbox Chromium fails to create its ProcessSingleton socket, so live browser runs must be issued outside it.

Phases that leave no artifact are invisible until a gate reads for them: Sprint 005 skipped Phase 3 and 4.1-4.3, and close Phase 2.6 was the only detector - jurisdictional_lock and no_interference were disabled while appearing enforced.

Verify a plan's stated rationale against its own acceptance criteria before executing it: Sprint 005's W5 claimed adding kind to the fallback hash would separate two voice notes that share kind, sender, minute and empty body, which it cannot.

Read probe output for what it contains rather than scanning it for the expected signal: the kind probe answered its question and also revealed emoji-only messages drawn as img alt, a loss larger than the media it was written for.

open_chat_by_query reports success without opening the requested chat - it clicks an unfiltered chat-list item and waits on a panel selector already satisfied when a conversation is open, so an export can be written for the wrong chat and exit 0.

A post-condition check MUST distinguish the state it intends to cause from the state that already held: a wait on an already-open panel, a click on an always-present list and a title read but never compared all passed while the search opened nothing.
Prove a regression test fails against the defective source before accepting the fix; stash the fix and run it - a test that passes against the broken code pins nothing.
Derive the next hotfix id from docs/hotfixes/H-*.md, never from prose in active_state.json: the anchor said H-004 while the directory did not exist and RA-03 made it H-001.
Fail closed when chat identity is unverifiable: chat_id is a digest and the title is never stored, so an export of the wrong chat is undetectable from the output file.

entries.lesson: audit_plan.py Filter 6 is a literal substring test, so a plan that PROHIBITS /loop is rejected exactly like one that uses it unguarded.
audit_plan.py is cited by three artifacts and exists in none: it is absent from .agents/scripts in v4.23.0, so a Phase 1 plan audit recorded as passing could not be reproduced.
scripts/install.py --target cursor deletes host-authored commands from the mirrored directory and then gitignores it, so the next such loss is invisible to git status.

session_cost.py reports 'no prior Claude transcript' from the anchor's session_tool field rather than from whether a transcript exists, so cost is unmeasurable whenever the anchor disagrees with the running harness.

A sampler with a node budget cannot prove absence: dumping the first N nodes in document order missed a marker nested 30 wrappers deep, and that miss is indistinguishable from the marker not existing.

Recording an inference with the confidence of a measurement is this project's recurring failure and the agent committed it too: three selectors matching zero nodes was read as evidence of a typed message, when the real cause was that no chat had those names.

An inactivity threshold needs negative evidence of activity, not just elapsed quiet: decide_stop called a panel stalled while a loading spinner was on screen, reporting a top the harvest never reached.
Measure the tool against a real browser before pointing it at real data: exercising the probe on a synthetic DOM found a defect that would have made the sprint answer H2 from missing evidence.
